changelog: Initial release. Parses AUDIO_TS from an .iso or a folder rip, extracts LPCM and MLP tracks to FLAC, and links hybrid video zones for Jellyfin's existing DVD playback.
description: Imports DVD-Audio groups as FLAC albums and links a hybrid VIDEO_TS zone into a movie library. Audio-only images are hidden from the movie resolver. CPPM-protected audio is skipped.
name: DVD-Audio
overview: Read a DVD-Audio disc into Music and Movie libraries.
